reasons: Cited Sections 18.1–18.2 match the preferred position point-for-point: CGL USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, professional E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M, maintained through the term plus one year, with certificates of insurance on request.

All obligations run against Vendor (counterparty), and extras (employer's liability, primary coverage, notice of cancellation, non-limitation of liability) are favorable to Customer, so nothing is under the fallback threshold.
Consistent with a compliant status, no redline or comment was proposed and the paragraphs are unchanged; deterministic check confirms an insurance obligation is present.
